Name: Label
Description: A display label for the UniverseScheme.

Name: Description
Description: A description of the content and purpose of the UniverseScheme.

Name: UniverseSchemeReference
Description: Allows the inclusion of a UniverseScheme by reference.

Name: UniverseReference
Description: Reference to a Universe, such as businesses in the manufacturing industry. A Universe describes units sharing a Unit Type and defining characteristics, independently of geographic area and time period. A Universe may be organized into hierarchical sub-universe classes.

Name: UniverseGroupReference
Description: Describes a group of Universes for organizational and management purposes.
